title.full: Signing up for CareShield Life for a family member

summary.text: Your family member needs their Singpass to apply. You can guide them or accompany them if they face difficulties.

steps.name: Use their Singpass
steps.text: Your family member needs their Singpass to sign up.

items: Your family member’s Singpass is required to sign up.

steps.name: Apply using the form
steps.text: Guide your family member to use their Singpass to apply with the Application to join CareShield Life form.

items: Guide your family member to use their Singpass to apply with the Application to join CareShield Life form.

steps.name: Wait for AIC’s advice
steps.text: Some applicants may need a disability assessment. After the application, Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) will inform your family member if one is required.

items: Some applicants may need a disability assessment.
After the application, Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) will inform your family member if one is required.

steps.name: Go with them if needed
steps.text: If your family member faces difficulties, accompany them to the Community Clubs/Centres to sign up.

items: If your family member faces difficulties, accompany them to the Community Clubs/Centres to sign up.

quotes.text: Your family member’s Singpass will be required to sign up for CareShield Life.
You can guide your family member to use his/her Singpass to apply for CareShield Life via the Application to join CareShield Life form.
Some applicants may need to undergo a disability assessment. Your family member will be informed by Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) if a disability assessment is required, after his/her application.
If they are facing difficulties, you can accompany them to the Community Clubs/Centres to sign up.
